words.enDefinition: healthcare focused on reducing risks or finding problems early

examples.en: The campus clinic listed preventive care separately from its drop-in services on the website.
examples.zh: 校园诊所网站把「预防性保健」和免预约服务分开介绍。

examples.en: I asked which office could explain preventive care for students living off campus.
examples.zh: 我问哪个部门能介绍住在校外的学生可以获得哪些「预防性保健」。

words.enDefinition: health services intended to prevent or detect health problems

examples.en: The clinic publishes a list of preventive services at the beginning of each term.
examples.zh: 诊所每学期开始时会公布「预防性医疗服务」清单。

examples.en: I asked which preventive services were included in the clinic's printed price list.
examples.zh: 我问诊所打印的价目表包含哪些「预防性医疗服务」。

words.enDefinition: a general physical examination done as part of regular care

examples.en: I asked how long the routine physical would take before booking a morning appointment.
examples.zh: 约早上的时段前，我先问了「常规体格检查」大概需要多久。

examples.en: The clinic gave me a summary of the routine physical to keep with my records.
examples.zh: 诊所给了我一份「常规体格检查」摘要，让我和自己的记录一起保存。

collocations: the cost of a routine physical

words.enDefinition: an initial evaluation recorded for comparison with later findings

examples.en: The clinician explained which measurements belonged to the baseline assessment on my form.
examples.zh: 医生解释了表上哪些测量值属于「基线评估」。

examples.en: I asked if the baseline assessment would be available in the student health portal.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在学生健康平台上查看「基线评估」。

words.enDefinition: a screening check that follows an earlier check or assessment

examples.en: The clinic's letter included a contact number for questions about follow-up screening.
examples.zh: 诊所的信上留了一个电话，可以咨询「后续筛查」。

examples.en: I asked how follow-up screening would appear in my online appointment record.
examples.zh: 我问网上就诊记录会怎样显示「后续筛查」。

words.enDefinition: an arranged visit for a check intended to spot possible problems

examples.en: I moved my screening appointment because the original time overlapped with a lecture.
examples.zh: 原来的时间和一节课撞了，我把「筛查预约」改了期。

examples.en: The confirmation email listed a separate entrance for the screening appointment on Monday.
examples.zh: 确认邮件说，周一的「筛查预约」要从另一个入口进去。

words.enDefinition: a plan showing when screening checks occur or are available

examples.en: The university posted the screening schedule outside the student health office yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 昨天下午，学校把「筛查时间安排」贴在了学生健康办公室外。

examples.en: I compared the screening schedule with my timetable before contacting the clinic.
examples.zh: 我把「筛查时间安排」跟自己的课表对了一下，才联系诊所。

words.enDefinition: the time between one screening check and the next

examples.en: I asked what screening interval meant in the letter from the screening program.
examples.zh: 我问筛查项目寄来的信里，「筛查间隔」是什么意思。

examples.en: The nurse explained where the screening interval appeared on my printed summary.
examples.zh: 护士指给我看打印出来的摘要上哪里写着「筛查间隔」。

words.enDefinition: a record of the screening checks someone has previously had

examples.en: The clinic asked whether I had a copy of my screening history from home.
examples.zh: 诊所问我有没有家乡那边的「筛查记录」副本。

examples.en: The portal displayed my screening history next to the most recent appointment date.
examples.zh: 平台把我的「筛查记录」显示在最近一次就诊日期旁边。

words.enDefinition: an organized service offering checks for a particular health issue

examples.en: I read about the screening program in a booklet from the campus health office.
examples.zh: 我在校园健康办公室发的册子里读到了这个「筛查项目」。

examples.en: The screening program had a phone line for students who needed information in another language.
examples.zh: 这个「筛查项目」有电话咨询，学生需要其他语言的说明时可以拨打。

words.enDefinition: a notice about an upcoming or available screening check

examples.en: I got a screening reminder on my phone just after the seminar ended.
examples.zh: 研讨课刚结束，我手机上就收到一条「筛查提醒」。

examples.en: The screening reminder included a link where I could check my appointment details.
examples.zh: 「筛查提醒」里有个链接，可以查看我的预约详情。

words.enDefinition: a test that looks for a condition or an increased chance of it

examples.en: I asked how the screening test would be listed in my medical record.
examples.zh: 我问「筛查检测」会怎样注明在我的医疗记录里。

examples.en: The clinic gave me a leaflet explaining the purpose of the screening test.
examples.zh: 诊所给我一份说明单，解释做这项「筛查检测」的目的。

words.enDefinition: findings from a check for possible disease or increased risk

examples.en: The clinic said my screening results would appear in the portal after review.
examples.zh: 诊所说，审核后我的「筛查结果」会显示在网上平台里。

examples.en: I asked when I could discuss my screening results with someone from the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问什么时候可以和诊所的工作人员谈谈我的「筛查结果」。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation of factors that may affect a person's health

examples.en: The campus clinic sent a health risk assessment form with the appointment confirmation.
examples.zh: 校园诊所随预约确认一起发来了一份「健康风险评估」表。

examples.en: I asked who would see my answers on the health risk assessment questionnaire.
examples.zh: 我问谁能看到我在「健康风险评估」问卷里填的答案。

words.enDefinition: work that helps people improve health or reduce health risks

examples.en: The university's health promotion team set up a table outside the dining hall.
examples.zh: 学校的「健康促进」团队在食堂外摆了张咨询桌。

examples.en: I took a health promotion leaflet because it listed services available to students.
examples.zh: 我拿了一份「健康促进」宣传单，因为上面列了学生可以使用的服务。

words.enDefinition: a message inviting someone to take part in a screening check

examples.en: My screening invitation gave an address for the clinic closest to my residence.
examples.zh: 我的「筛查邀请」上写了离住处最近的诊所地址。

examples.en: I wasn't sure whether the screening invitation applied to exchange students, so I asked.
examples.zh: 我不确定这份「筛查邀请」是否面向交换生，就问了一下。

words.enDefinition: confirmation that someone has met specified health requirements

examples.en: My placement coordinator told me where to check whether I had health clearance.
examples.zh: 实习协调员告诉我在哪里能查自己是否已「健康审核通过」。

examples.en: I asked what health clearance meant in the university's message about my placement.
examples.zh: 我问学校那封关于实习的消息里，「健康审核通过」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a form recording information needed to confirm health requirements

examples.en: The department asked me to submit a health clearance form before my first placement.
examples.zh: 院系要求我在第一次实习前提交一份「健康审核表」。

examples.en: I asked the clinic which sections of the health clearance form it could complete.
examples.zh: 我问诊所，「健康审核表」的哪些部分可以由他们填写。

words.enDefinition: a record of health information held for an individual student

examples.en: I asked who could access my student health record after I transferred to another campus.
examples.zh: 转到另一个校区以后，我问谁能查看我的「学生健康档案」。

examples.en: The nurse checked my student health record to see whether the document had arrived.
examples.zh: 护士查看了我的「学生健康档案」，确认文件有没有收到。

words.enDefinition: an online system connecting students with health records or services

examples.en: I uploaded the form to the student health portal after my morning class.
examples.zh: 上午下课后，我把表格传到了「学生健康平台」。

examples.en: The student health portal showed a message from the nurse about my submitted record.
examples.zh: 「学生健康平台」上有护士发来的消息，说的是我提交的记录。

collocations: log into the student health portal
update the student health portal profile
upload to the student health portal

words.enDefinition: required health-related records or checks specified by a school

examples.en: The orientation guide listed student health requirements for people starting a clinical placement.
examples.zh: 迎新指南列出了开始临床实习的「学生健康要求」。

examples.en: I asked whether the student health requirements applied to my particular exchange course.
examples.zh: 我问这些「学生健康要求」是否适用于我那门交换课程。

collocations: a list of student health requirements

words.enDefinition: a school form for recording a student's health information

examples.en: I forgot the school health form, so the office emailed me another copy.
examples.zh: 我忘带「学校健康登记表」了，办公室又发给我一份。

examples.en: The school health form had a space for the clinic's contact details and signature.
examples.zh: 「学校健康登记表」上留有填写诊所联系方式和签名的位置。

words.enDefinition: a form where a person reports specified information about their health

examples.en: I asked whether I could submit the health declaration form before arriving at the residence.
examples.zh: 我问能否在抵达宿舍前提交「健康申报表」。

examples.en: The office emailed a new health declaration form because the previous link had expired.
examples.zh: 之前的链接过期了，办公室发来一份新的「健康申报表」。

words.enDefinition: the process of registering a student with a school's health service

examples.en: The university explained student health registration at the same orientation session as library registration.
examples.zh: 学校在同一场迎新会上介绍了「学生健康登记」和图书馆登记。

examples.en: I asked when student health registration would open for students arriving later this term.
examples.zh: 我问这学期晚到的学生什么时候可以办理「学生健康登记」。

words.enDefinition: a field concerned with health and safety in the workplace

examples.en: My placement coordinator referred my question to the occupational health team at the hospital.
examples.zh: 我的实习协调员把我的问题转给了医院的「职业健康」团队。

examples.en: The training pack listed an email address for occupational health enquiries from students.
examples.zh: 培训资料列了一个邮箱，供学生咨询「职业健康」相关问题。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation of how health relates to a person's work

examples.en: I asked which documents to bring to my occupational health assessment next week.
examples.zh: 我问下周参加「职业健康评估」时要带哪些材料。

examples.en: The clinic sent confirmation of my occupational health assessment to the placement coordinator.
examples.zh: 诊所把我的「职业健康评估」确认通知发给了实习协调员。

words.enDefinition: a physical examination arranged before someone starts a job

examples.en: The placement office asked if I had a date for the pre-employment physical yet.
examples.zh: 实习办公室问我有没有定下「入职前体检」的日期。

examples.en: I asked which clinic could complete the paperwork for my pre-employment physical.
examples.zh: 我问哪家诊所可以帮我填好「入职前体检」的材料。

words.enDefinition: a list for checking whether specified health requirements are met

examples.en: I used the health requirements checklist to see which documents were still missing.
examples.zh: 我用「健康要求核对清单」查看还有哪些材料没交。

examples.en: The department updated its health requirements checklist after changing the online submission process.
examples.zh: 院系调整网上提交流程后，更新了「健康要求核对清单」。

words.enDefinition: a document confirming someone can work under stated conditions

examples.en: I asked who could issue a fitness-to-work certificate for my new placement.
examples.zh: 我问新的实习岗位要交「适岗健康证明」，这份证明可以由谁开。

examples.en: The office asked whether the fitness-to-work certificate showed the date of the assessment.
examples.zh: 办公室问「适岗健康证明」上有没有注明评估日期。

words.enDefinition: permission for specified health records to be shared with someone

examples.en: I signed a medical records release so the campus clinic could request my old record.
examples.zh: 我签了「病历共享授权」，让校园诊所可以向原来的诊所要我的病历。

examples.en: The medical records release named the clinic authorized to receive the selected documents.
examples.zh: 「病历共享授权」写明哪家诊所获准接收指定文件。

words.enDefinition: someone permitted to receive a specific document or information

examples.en: I checked who the authorized recipient was before the clinic sent the records.
examples.zh: 诊所发病历之前，我确认了「获授权接收人」是谁。

examples.en: The form asked me to enter the name of the authorized recipient clearly.
examples.zh: 表格请我清楚填写「获授权接收人」的姓名。

words.enDefinition: documents recording someone's health information or completed checks

examples.en: The placement office asked me where I had uploaded my health documentation.
examples.zh: 实习办公室问我把「健康资料文件」传到了哪个位置。

examples.en: I kept copies of the health documentation I submitted at the start of term.
examples.zh: 我保存了学期初提交的「健康资料文件」的副本。

words.enDefinition: a document used to record findings from a physical examination

examples.en: I took the medical examination form to the clinic on Friday morning before class.
examples.zh: 周五上午上课前，我带着「体检表」去了诊所。

examples.en: The receptionist told me when the completed medical examination form would be ready for collection.
examples.zh: 前台告诉我，填好的「体检表」什么时候可以来取。

collocations: a copy of the medical examination form

words.enDefinition: a letter confirming medical suitability for a specified activity

examples.en: The exchange office asked me to upload a medical clearance letter for the placement.
examples.zh: 交换项目办公室请我为实习上传一份「健康合格证明函」。

examples.en: I asked whether the medical clearance letter needed to name the particular activity.
examples.zh: 我问「健康合格证明函」是否需要写明具体是哪项活动。

words.enDefinition: documentation showing that a person has received specified vaccinations

examples.en: The placement office asked for proof of immunization in a separate upload field.
examples.zh: 实习办公室要求在单独的上传栏提交「接种证明材料」。

examples.en: I asked whether my clinic's printout counted as proof of immunization for this program.
examples.zh: 我问这诊所打印的单子能不能算这个项目的「接种证明材料」。

words.enDefinition: a record listing vaccinations a person has received

examples.en: I requested a copy of my immunization record before leaving for the exchange.
examples.zh: 出发去交换以前，我先申请了一份自己的「免疫接种记录」。

examples.en: The nurse checked the date on my immunization record against the clinic's notes.
examples.zh: 护士把我的「免疫接种记录」上的日期和诊所记录对了一下。

collocations: a copy of the immunization record

words.enDefinition: a formal document certifying one or more recorded vaccinations

examples.en: The university asked whether I had an English version of my vaccination certificate.
examples.zh: 学校问我的「疫苗接种证明书」有没有可供阅读的英文版。

examples.en: I asked where I could download the vaccination certificate after the office updated my record.
examples.zh: 办公室更新我的记录后，我问到哪里能下载「疫苗接种证明书」。

words.enDefinition: a card that holds written details of a person's vaccinations

examples.en: I showed my vaccination card when the clinic asked about my earlier appointments.
examples.zh: 诊所问我之前的预约时，我出示了「疫苗接种卡」。

examples.en: The date on my vaccination card was harder to read than the online entry.
examples.zh: 我的「疫苗接种卡」上的日期比网上记录更难看清。

collocations: a copy of a vaccination card

words.enDefinition: information about whether specified vaccinations have already been received

examples.en: The portal showed my vaccination status after a nurse checked the uploaded document.
examples.zh: 护士核对上传的文件后，平台显示了我的「疫苗接种状态」。

examples.en: I asked who could see my vaccination status on the placement checklist.
examples.zh: 我问谁能看到实习清单上我的「疫苗接种状态」。

words.enDefinition: the day on which a vaccine was given

examples.en: The form asked for the vaccination date exactly as it appeared on my record.
examples.zh: 表格要求照着我的记录填写「接种日期」。

examples.en: The nurse checked the vaccination date before signing the copy for me.
examples.zh: 护士核对了「接种日期」，才在给我的副本上签字。

words.enDefinition: the product or vaccine type recorded for a vaccination

examples.en: I could not read the vaccine name on the handwritten card from home.
examples.zh: 我看不清从家乡带来的手写卡片上的「疫苗名称」。

examples.en: The clinic checked the vaccine name before sending the corrected record to me.
examples.zh: 诊所核对了「疫苗名称」，才把更正后的记录发给我。

words.enDefinition: a code identifying a particular manufactured batch of vaccine

examples.en: I asked why the vaccine lot number was printed beside the product name.
examples.zh: 我问为什么产品名旁边印着「疫苗生产批号」。

examples.en: The nurse checked the vaccine lot number against what was listed in the record.
examples.zh: 护士把「疫苗生产批号」与记录上列的编号作了核对。

words.enDefinition: a database that combines vaccination records for registered individuals

examples.en: The clinic looked up my previous record in its regional immunization registry.
examples.zh: 诊所在地区「免疫接种登记系统」里查找了我先前的记录。

examples.en: I asked who could access my record through the immunization registry after I moved.
examples.zh: 搬家后，我问谁可以通过「免疫接种登记系统」查看我的记录。

collocations: an entry in the immunization registry
retrieve a record from the immunization registry

words.enDefinition: a plan indicating when particular vaccinations are generally due

examples.en: I asked which immunization schedule the campus health page was referring to.
examples.zh: 我问校园健康网页指的是哪一份「免疫接种时间表」。

examples.en: The nurse showed me where the immunization schedule appeared in the reference material.
examples.zh: 护士告诉我，参考材料中哪里有「免疫接种时间表」。

words.enDefinition: an arranged visit to a service that provides vaccinations

examples.en: I checked the address on my vaccination appointment confirmation before leaving campus.
examples.zh: 离开学校之前，我核对了「疫苗接种预约」确认通知上的地址。

examples.en: My vaccination appointment overlapped with a tutorial, so I asked about another time.
examples.zh: 我的「疫苗接种预约」和辅导课撞了，就问能不能换个时间。

words.enDefinition: a service or site set up to provide vaccinations

examples.en: The temporary vaccination clinic was in the sports hall beside the library.
examples.zh: 临时「疫苗接种门诊」设在图书馆旁的体育馆。

examples.en: The university posted an accessible entrance for the vaccination clinic on its website.
examples.zh: 学校在网站上公布了「疫苗接种门诊」的无障碍入口。

words.enDefinition: a document used to record permission for vaccination

examples.en: I asked for a copy of the vaccination consent form before leaving the clinic.
examples.zh: 离开诊所前，我索要了一份「疫苗接种同意书」副本。

examples.en: The nurse gave me time to read the vaccination consent form and ask questions.
examples.zh: 护士留了时间让我看「疫苗接种同意书」并提问。

words.enDefinition: a CDC document explaining a vaccine's benefits and risks

examples.en: The U.S. clinic handed me a Vaccine Information Statement to read before the appointment.
examples.zh: 美国的诊所给了我一份「美国疫苗信息说明单」，让我在就诊前阅读。

examples.en: I asked where to find the date on the Vaccine Information Statement I received.
examples.zh: 我问拿到的「美国疫苗信息说明单」上哪里印着日期。

collocations: a copy of the Vaccine Information Statement

words.enDefinition: a condition specifying vaccination evidence needed for an activity

examples.en: The placement handbook listed an immunization requirement and named an office for questions.
examples.zh: 实习手册列了一项「免疫接种要求」，并写了负责解答问题的部门。

examples.en: I asked when the immunization requirement had been added to this year's checklist.
examples.zh: 我问这项「免疫接种要求」是什么时候加到今年的清单上的。

words.enDefinition: permission to be excused from a specified vaccination requirement

examples.en: The office told me who handled questions about a vaccination exemption for placement.
examples.zh: 办公室告诉我，要咨询实习的「接种豁免」应该找谁。

examples.en: I asked whether the uploaded document showed my vaccination exemption for this course.
examples.zh: 我问上传的文件有没有显示我在这门课上的「接种豁免」。

words.enDefinition: a change that fixes inaccurate information in a vaccination record

examples.en: I asked how to request a vaccine record correction for my misspelled surname.
examples.zh: 我的姓拼错了，我问怎样申请「接种记录更正」。

examples.en: The clinic sent a message once the vaccine record correction appeared in the portal.
examples.zh: 网上平台显示「接种记录更正」后，诊所发来了一条消息。

words.enDefinition: the initial set of vaccine doses intended to build protection

examples.en: The nurse showed me where the primary series was listed on my printout.
examples.zh: 护士告诉我，打印单上哪里写着「基础免疫程序」。

examples.en: I asked whether the record from home showed my full primary series.
examples.zh: 我问从家乡带来的记录是否列出了我的完整「基础免疫程序」。

collocations: the dates of a primary series

words.enDefinition: an additional dose aimed at maintaining or restoring vaccine protection

examples.en: I asked where the booster dose appeared on my immunization printout.
examples.zh: 我问免疫接种记录打印单上哪里注明了「加强剂次」。

examples.en: The nurse checked whether the booster dose was listed under the right year.
examples.zh: 护士核对了「加强剂次」有没有列在正确的年份下面。

collocations: the date of a booster dose

words.enDefinition: vaccination considered in connection with planned travel abroad

examples.en: The campus booklet listed contact information for the travel vaccination clinic nearby.
examples.zh: 校园册子上列出了附近那家「旅行相关接种」诊所的联系方式。

examples.en: I asked which page had information about travel vaccination for exchange students.
examples.zh: 我问哪一页介绍了交换生的「旅行相关接种」。

words.enDefinition: an organized effort offering vaccination during a particular time of year

examples.en: The college announced a seasonal vaccination campaign in a message about autumn health services.
examples.zh: 学院在秋季健康服务通知中公布了一项「季节性接种活动」。

examples.en: I asked whether the seasonal vaccination campaign would have a site on our campus.
examples.zh: 我问「季节性接种活动」会不会在我们校区设点。

collocations: information about a seasonal vaccination campaign

words.enDefinition: a record entry for an individual dose of a vaccine

examples.en: The nurse noticed that my vaccine dose record had the wrong appointment date.
examples.zh: 护士注意到我的「疫苗剂次记录」上就诊日期写错了。

examples.en: I requested a copy of the vaccine dose record from the clinic for my files.
examples.zh: 我向诊所索要了一份「疫苗剂次记录」副本留档。

collocations: a copy of the vaccine dose record

words.enDefinition: vaccination intended to make up doses that were missed earlier

examples.en: I asked the nurse what catch-up vaccination meant on the clinic's services page.
examples.zh: 我问护士，诊所服务网页上的「疫苗补种」是什么意思。

examples.en: The school's guide listed a phone number for questions about catch-up vaccination.
examples.zh: 学校指南列出了一个电话号码，可以咨询「疫苗补种」。

words.enDefinition: a check for possible tuberculosis or signs of infection

examples.en: The placement form had a section for the date of my tuberculosis screening.
examples.zh: 实习表格留了一栏，填我的「结核病筛查」日期。

examples.en: I asked which clinic could provide written evidence of tuberculosis screening for my records.
examples.zh: 我问哪家诊所能提供「结核病筛查」的书面材料让我留存。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation of factors associated with possible tuberculosis exposure or disease

examples.en: I asked where to find the TB risk assessment form in the student portal.
examples.zh: 我问在学生平台上哪里能找到「结核病风险评估」表。

examples.en: The nurse explained who would review my TB risk assessment after I submitted it.
examples.zh: 护士说了我提交「结核病风险评估」后会由谁审核。

words.enDefinition: confirmation that someone meets a program's tuberculosis screening requirements

examples.en: My placement office asked whether my TB clearance was visible in the portal.
examples.zh: 实习办公室问，我的「结核病筛查审核通过」状态在平台上看不看得到。

examples.en: I asked who could confirm my TB clearance after the clinic sent the document.
examples.zh: 诊所发出文件后，我问谁可以确认我「结核病筛查审核通过」。

words.enDefinition: a chest X-ray examination carried out to look for signs of a condition

examples.en: I asked which date referred to the screening chest X-ray on the printed form.
examples.zh: 我问打印表上的哪个日期对应那次「筛查性胸部X线检查」。

examples.en: The clinic asked whether I needed a copy of the screening chest X-ray report.
examples.zh: 诊所问我需不需要一份「筛查性胸部X线检查」报告副本。

collocations: a report on a screening chest X-ray
an appointment for a screening chest X-ray

words.enDefinition: a brief check to identify people who may have hearing difficulties

examples.en: The campus health fair listed hearing screening among the services available that afternoon.
examples.zh: 校园健康活动把「听力筛查」列为当天下午可用的服务之一。

examples.en: I asked whether my hearing screening results would be available on a printed sheet.
examples.zh: 我问能不能拿到一张印有「听力筛查」结果的单子。

words.enDefinition: measurement of the pressure exerted by blood on artery walls

examples.en: The campus health office listed a blood pressure check on the event poster.
examples.zh: 校园健康办公室在活动海报上列了「血压测量」。

examples.en: I asked the nurse where my blood pressure check was recorded on the form.
examples.zh: 我问护士，「血压测量」记录在表格的哪里。

words.enDefinition: the number of heartbeats per minute when a person is resting

examples.en: The nurse showed me where resting heart rate appeared on the checkup summary.
examples.zh: 护士告诉我体检摘要上哪里写着「静息心率」。

examples.en: I asked which number on the form referred to my resting heart rate.
examples.zh: 我问表上的哪个数字指的是我的「静息心率」。

collocations: a field for resting heart rate

words.enDefinition: a number calculated from a person's height and weight

examples.en: I asked why body mass index was listed beside height on the form.
examples.zh: 我问表格为什么把「体重指数」列在身高旁边。

examples.en: The clinician pointed out where my body mass index was recorded in the summary.
examples.zh: 医生给我指出了摘要里记录我的「体重指数」的位置。

collocations: a field for body mass index

words.enDefinition: the distance measured around the waist

examples.en: The nurse showed me where waist circumference appeared on my printed record.
examples.zh: 护士给我指了打印记录上「腰围」的位置。

examples.en: I asked if the number beside waist circumference was listed in centimeters.
examples.zh: 我问「腰围」旁边的数字是不是用厘米记的。

words.enDefinition: a recorded check of how tall a person is

examples.en: The nurse added my height measurement to the form before saving it.
examples.zh: 护士保存表格前，把我的「身高测量」结果加了上去。

examples.en: I asked whether the height measurement on the summary was from this visit.
examples.zh: 我问摘要里的「身高测量」结果是不是这次就诊记的。

words.enDefinition: a recorded check of how much a person weighs

examples.en: The report listed my weight measurement with the date of the appointment.
examples.zh: 报告列了我的「体重测量」结果，还注明了就诊日期。

examples.en: I asked if the weight measurement was shown in pounds or kilograms.
examples.zh: 我问「体重测量」结果是用磅还是千克显示的。

words.enDefinition: checking cholesterol levels as part of a preventive assessment

examples.en: I asked where cholesterol screening was listed on the clinic's services page.
examples.zh: 我问诊所的服务网页哪里列了「胆固醇筛查」。

examples.en: The campus clinic had a leaflet explaining the term cholesterol screening in plain language.
examples.zh: 校园诊所有一份宣传单，用通俗的话解释「胆固醇筛查」。

words.enDefinition: a group of blood tests measuring different fats in blood

examples.en: The report listed a lipid panel with several values beneath the heading.
examples.zh: 报告里有一项「血脂全套检查」，标题下面列着好几个数值。

examples.en: I asked the clinician to explain what the lipid panel heading covered.
examples.zh: 我请医生解释「血脂全套检查」这个标题下面包括哪些项目。

words.enDefinition: checking blood sugar to look for possible problems with its regulation

examples.en: The event flyer listed blood glucose screening as one of the available checks.
examples.zh: 活动宣传单把「血糖筛查」列为可以做的检查之一。

examples.en: I asked whether my blood glucose screening result would appear on the clinic's portal.
examples.zh: 我问自己的「血糖筛查」结果会不会出现在诊所的平台上。

words.enDefinition: a blood test reflecting average blood sugar over recent months

examples.en: I asked what A1C test meant after seeing it on my test order.
examples.zh: 我在检验申请上看到「糖化血红蛋白检测」，就问这是什么意思。

examples.en: The clinician pointed to the A1C test entry in the results list.
examples.zh: 医生指了指结果清单里「糖化血红蛋白检测」那一项。

words.enDefinition: a set of blood tests ordered as part of regular care

examples.en: The nurse explained where my routine blood work results would appear after the visit.
examples.zh: 护士告诉我，就诊后我的「常规验血」结果会显示在哪里。

examples.en: I asked which tests were included in the routine blood work listed on my form.
examples.zh: 我问表格上写的「常规验血」包括哪些检测项目。

collocations: a request for routine blood work

words.enDefinition: a blood test measuring the amounts and characteristics of blood cells

examples.en: The clinician pointed out the complete blood count section on my printed report.
examples.zh: 医生给我指出了打印报告里「全血细胞计数」那一节。

examples.en: I asked whether the complete blood count was the test the nurse had mentioned.
examples.zh: 我问「全血细胞计数」是不是护士之前提到的那项检测。

words.enDefinition: a breast X-ray examination used to look for early signs of cancer

examples.en: The nurse explained which document was the screening mammogram report in my file.
examples.zh: 护士告诉我，档案里哪份文件是「乳腺X线筛查」报告。

examples.en: I asked which office kept copies of the images from the screening mammogram.
examples.zh: 我问哪个办公室留有「乳腺X线筛查」的影像副本。

collocations: an invitation for a screening mammogram

words.enDefinition: a preventive check looking for signs of risk of cervical cancer

examples.en: The clinic's booklet listed a separate phone number for cervical screening queries.
examples.zh: 诊所的册子里单独列了一个咨询「宫颈筛查」的电话号码。

examples.en: I asked who could explain the cervical screening entry in my online record.
examples.zh: 我问谁能解释我网上记录里的「宫颈筛查」这一项。

words.enDefinition: a test checking cells from the cervix for abnormal changes

examples.en: I asked how a Pap test would appear in the clinic's appointment system.
examples.zh: 我问「宫颈细胞学检测」在诊所预约系统上会怎么显示。

examples.en: The clinician explained where the result of the Pap test was filed.
examples.zh: 医生告诉我，「宫颈细胞学检测」结果存在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: a test looking for certain types of human papillomavirus

examples.en: I asked the nurse what HPV test meant on the printed requisition.
examples.zh: 我问护士，打印出来的申请单上「人乳头瘤病毒检测」是什么意思。

examples.en: The clinic told me when my HPV test report would be available.
examples.zh: 诊所告诉我什么时候可以查看「人乳头瘤病毒检测」报告。

words.enDefinition: testing to look for early colorectal cancer or signs of risk

examples.en: I noticed information about colorectal cancer screening on the health office's noticeboard.
examples.zh: 我在健康办公室的公告栏上看到了「结直肠癌筛查」资料。

examples.en: The booklet listed a separate helpline for questions about colorectal cancer screening.
examples.zh: 册子单独列了一个电话，可以咨询「结直肠癌筛查」。

words.enDefinition: an examination looking for possible early signs of skin cancer

examples.en: I asked whether the clinic offered skin cancer screening at that particular location.
examples.zh: 我问诊所在那个点是否提供「皮肤癌筛查」。

examples.en: The service list had a short explanation of skin cancer screening near the bottom.
examples.zh: 服务清单靠下的位置有一段「皮肤癌筛查」的简短说明。

words.enDefinition: checking bone mineral density to assess possible bone loss

examples.en: I asked whether the hospital had written information about bone density screening in English.
examples.zh: 我问医院有没有「骨密度筛查」方面的英文书面资料。

examples.en: The clinic listed bone density screening on its separate page for scheduled checks.
examples.zh: 诊所在单列的预约检查页面上写了「骨密度筛查」。

collocations: a description of bone density screening

words.enDefinition: the requirements for being offered a particular screening check

examples.en: I asked who decided screening eligibility for people joining the program this term.
examples.zh: 我问，谁负责确认本学期报名者的「筛查参与条件」。

examples.en: The website listed an email address for questions about screening eligibility.
examples.zh: 网站列了一个邮箱，可以咨询「筛查参与条件」。

words.enDefinition: look for signs of a condition using a screening test

examples.en: I asked what the check was intended to screen for before booking.
examples.zh: 预约之前，我问这项检查是为了「筛查」什么问题。

examples.en: The leaflet explained what the program was designed to screen for that year.
examples.zh: 宣传单介绍了这个项目当年要「筛查」哪些问题。

collocations: a test to screen for disease
offer to screen for a health risk

words.enDefinition: a document requesting a laboratory or other medical test

examples.en: I asked whether I needed the original test requisition for my appointment.
examples.zh: 我问就诊时需不需要带「检验申请单」原件。

examples.en: The nurse showed me the clinic name printed on the test requisition.
examples.zh: 护士给我看了「检验申请单」上印的诊所名称。

collocations: a copy of the test requisition

words.enDefinition: a clinician's request specifying laboratory tests to be done

examples.en: The lab asked when the clinic had submitted my lab order electronically.
examples.zh: 检验室问诊所是什么时候用电子系统提交我的「实验室检验医嘱」的。

examples.en: I asked which tests appeared under the new lab order on screen.
examples.zh: 我问屏幕上新的「实验室检验医嘱」下面列了哪些检测。

words.enDefinition: the process of obtaining material for a laboratory test

examples.en: I asked where my specimen collection appointment would take place on campus.
examples.zh: 我问校园里的「标本采集」预约在哪儿进行。

examples.en: The receptionist pointed to the sign for the specimen collection area nearby.
examples.zh: 前台指了指附近那块写着「标本采集」区的指示牌。

words.enDefinition: a container used to hold material for a test

examples.en: The clerk compared the label on the sample container with the request.
examples.zh: 工作人员把「样本容器」上的标签与申请单作了核对。

examples.en: I asked whether the sample container barcode was the number shown in the portal.
examples.zh: 我问「样本容器」的条码是不是网上平台显示的那个编号。

words.enDefinition: a label identifying a sample and its associated information

examples.en: The technician checked the specimen label before accepting the package at reception.
examples.zh: 技术人员先核对了「标本标签」，才在接待处接收包裹。

examples.en: I asked which date on the specimen label matched the date on the form.
examples.zh: 我问「标本标签」上的哪个日期和表格上的日期一致。

collocations: a barcode on the specimen label

words.enDefinition: a code uniquely identifying a sample in a laboratory system

examples.en: The clerk asked for the specimen ID visible beneath the printed barcode.
examples.zh: 工作人员让我提供印刷条码下方的「标本识别编号」。

examples.en: I used the specimen ID on the receipt when calling about my report.
examples.zh: 我打电话问报告时，用了收据上的「标本识别编号」。

words.enDefinition: the date a specific test sample was obtained

examples.en: The report showed a collection date different from the date it was released.
examples.zh: 报告显示的「采集日期」和报告发布日期不一样。

examples.en: I asked whether the collection date appeared next to my name on the record.
examples.zh: 我问记录上「采集日期」是不是写在我的名字旁边。

words.enDefinition: a portion of blood taken for a laboratory test

examples.en: I asked which report corresponded to the blood sample mentioned in my record.
examples.zh: 我问哪份报告对应我的记录里提到的那个「血液样本」。

examples.en: The nurse checked that the blood sample identifier matched the clinic's paperwork.
examples.zh: 护士确认了「血液样本」编号与诊所的材料一致。

collocations: a report for a blood sample

words.enDefinition: a portion of urine provided for a laboratory test

examples.en: The clinician clarified which report was for my urine sample that morning.
examples.zh: 医生解释了哪份报告对应我那天上午的「尿液样本」。

examples.en: I asked whether the urine sample had reached the lab from the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问「尿液样本」有没有从诊所送到检验室。

collocations: a report for a urine sample

words.enDefinition: a portion of feces provided for analysis by a laboratory

examples.en: The technician confirmed receipt of the stool sample on the following morning.
examples.zh: 技术人员在第二天上午确认收到了「粪便样本」。

examples.en: I asked where to find the stool sample entry in the results portal.
examples.zh: 我问结果平台上哪里显示「粪便样本」的记录。

words.enDefinition: material collected with a swab for a laboratory test

examples.en: I checked which label referred to the swab sample collected at the clinic.
examples.zh: 我确认了哪个标签对应在诊所采集的「拭子样本」。

examples.en: The nurse told me where the swab sample result would appear online.
examples.zh: 护士告诉我，「拭子样本」检测结果在网上哪里显示。

words.enDefinition: the process of taking a test sample to the receiving site

examples.en: I called the lab to ask about sample drop-off before my morning class.
examples.zh: 上午上课前，我给检验室打电话问了「样本交送」。

examples.en: The sign listed sample drop-off hours separately from the front desk opening hours.
examples.zh: 牌子把「样本交送」的时间和前台开门的时间分开列。

words.enDefinition: the place where samples are obtained for laboratory testing

examples.en: The booking email gave directions to the collection site behind the library.
examples.zh: 预约邮件说明了怎么到图书馆后面的「标本采集点」。

examples.en: I checked whether the collection site on my form had an accessible entrance.
examples.zh: 我确认了表格上那个「标本采集点」有没有无障碍入口。

words.enDefinition: a bag used to contain and transport a test specimen

examples.en: The clerk compared the code on the specimen bag with my form.
examples.zh: 工作人员把「标本袋」上的代码与我的表格作了核对。

examples.en: I asked which number on the specimen bag was the reference on my receipt.
examples.zh: 我问「标本袋」上的哪个编号是我收据上的参考号。

collocations: a barcode on the specimen bag

words.enDefinition: a trip to a medical laboratory for testing or to provide a sample

examples.en: I went back to class after a short lab visit at the campus health centre.
examples.zh: 我在校园健康中心「到检验室做检查」，很快就回去上课了。

examples.en: My lab visit finished before noon, so I caught the earlier bus home.
examples.zh: 我「到检验室做检查」时没耽误太久，中午前就做完了，所以赶上了更早一班回家的公交。

collocations: go in for a lab visit
the date of the lab visit

words.enDefinition: the work a laboratory performs to prepare or analyze samples

examples.en: The portal showed that lab processing had started after the sample arrived.
examples.zh: 样本送达后，网上平台显示已经开始「检验室处理」。

examples.en: I asked who to contact about the stage marked lab processing online.
examples.zh: 我问网上标着「检验室处理」的阶段应该联系谁咨询。

words.enDefinition: the time a test service takes to produce a result

examples.en: I asked about the test turnaround time before booking my follow-up appointment.
examples.zh: 预约后续就诊前，我先问了「检测出结果所需时间」。

examples.en: The leaflet listed a test turnaround time for each category of checks.
examples.zh: 说明单为每类检查列了「检测出结果所需时间」。

words.enDefinition: a message that lets someone know a result is available

examples.en: I got the result notification on my phone during the bus ride home.
examples.zh: 我坐公交回家的时候，手机上收到了「结果发布通知」。

examples.en: The result notification linked to the portal without including my health details.
examples.zh: 「结果发布通知」有平台链接，里面没有我个人的健康详情。

words.enDefinition: the date a test result is made available to its recipients

examples.en: I asked where the result release date would appear in my account.
examples.zh: 我问「结果发布日期」会出现在我账户里的哪个位置。

examples.en: The clinic wrote the result release date next to the report number.
examples.zh: 诊所把「结果发布日期」写在报告编号旁边。

words.enDefinition: a document summarizing findings from tests performed in a laboratory

examples.en: I asked for a copy of the laboratory test report after the clinic called.
examples.zh: 诊所打来电话后，我索要了一份「实验室检验报告」副本。

examples.en: The nurse asked me to bring my previous laboratory test report to the appointment.
examples.zh: 护士请我就诊时带上以前的「实验室检验报告」。

collocations: a copy of the laboratory test report

words.enDefinition: a copy of a document intended for the patient's records

examples.en: I asked whether I could get a patient copy of the completed form.
examples.zh: 我问能不能给我一份填好表格的「患者留存联」。

examples.en: The clerk handed me the patient copy to keep with my other papers.
examples.zh: 工作人员把「患者留存联」交给我，让我和其他材料一起保存。

words.enDefinition: a comparison interval supplied by the lab for interpreting a measurement

examples.en: I asked why the report printed a reference range alongside each recorded value.
examples.zh: 我问报告为什么在每个记录的数值旁边都印一个「参考区间」。

examples.en: The nurse pointed to the reference range before explaining what the column meant.
examples.zh: 护士先指了指「参考区间」，再解释那一栏的意思。

words.enDefinition: the standard unit used to express a measured quantity

examples.en: I asked what measurement unit the lab used for that particular entry.
examples.zh: 我问检验室那一项用的是什么「计量单位」。

examples.en: The report placed the measurement unit beside the number in a separate column.
examples.zh: 报告把「计量单位」放在数字旁边的单独一栏。

words.enDefinition: the numerical measurement recorded as the result of an individual test

examples.en: I asked which test value the clinician was referring to on the report.
examples.zh: 我问医生指的是报告上的哪个「检测数值」。

examples.en: The test value appeared on the same line as the measurement unit.
examples.zh: 「检测数值」和计量单位显示在同一行。

words.enDefinition: a finding classified as expected under the test's criteria

examples.en: I asked what the words normal result meant in the clinic's report.
examples.zh: 我问诊所报告里「正常结果」这个标签是什么意思。

examples.en: The nurse pointed out which line was marked as a normal result.
examples.zh: 护士给我指出了哪一行标着「正常结果」。

collocations: a report showing a normal result

words.enDefinition: a finding that differs from the test's expected criteria

examples.en: I asked to discuss the abnormal result with the clinician who ordered the test.
examples.zh: 我请开检验单的医生和我谈谈那个「异常结果」。

examples.en: The clinic told me whom to contact about the abnormal result on my report.
examples.zh: 诊所告诉我，报告里的「异常结果」应该找谁咨询。

words.enDefinition: a finding close to the cutoff between different test classifications

examples.en: The clinician explained the term borderline result in the summary of my test.
examples.zh: 医生解释了检测摘要里的「临界结果」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked which entry on the report was labeled as a borderline result.
examples.zh: 我问报告上哪一项标成了「临界结果」。

words.enDefinition: a finding that does not support a definite interpretation

examples.en: The clinic called to explain the inconclusive result shown on the report.
examples.zh: 诊所打电话解释了报告上写的「未能判定的结果」。

examples.en: I asked who could answer my questions about the inconclusive result after class.
examples.zh: 我问下课后可以找谁咨询这个「未能判定的结果」。

collocations: a letter with an inconclusive result

words.enDefinition: a screening outcome that does not flag the target condition

examples.en: I checked what the program meant by a negative screening result in its leaflet.
examples.zh: 我查看了项目说明单上「筛查阴性结果」的含义。

examples.en: The letter gave the date on which my negative screening result was recorded.
examples.zh: 信里注明了我的「筛查阴性结果」是哪天记入记录的。

collocations: a letter with a negative screening result
ask about a negative screening result

words.enDefinition: a screening finding meeting criteria for a possible target issue

examples.en: I asked whether a positive screening result and a diagnosis meant different things in the report.
examples.zh: 我问报告里「筛查阳性结果」和诊断是不是两回事。

examples.en: The clinic listed a contact number next to the positive screening result in my letter.
examples.zh: 诊所在我的信里「筛查阳性结果」旁留了联系电话。

collocations: a letter with a positive screening result
ask about a positive screening result

words.enDefinition: a positive test finding when the target issue is absent

examples.en: The clinician explained what false positive meant without commenting on my particular result.
examples.zh: 医生解释了「假阳性」的意思，没有对我那份结果作判断。

examples.en: The workshop used a fictional example to explain a false positive to students.
examples.zh: 讲座用一个虚构例子给学生解释「假阳性」。

words.enDefinition: a negative test finding when the target issue is present

examples.en: The screening booklet included a short example of what a false negative means.
examples.zh: 筛查册子里有个简短的例子，说明「假阴性」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked what the term false negative meant in the program information sheet.
examples.zh: 我问项目资料单上「假阴性」这个词是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: the proportion correctly testing positive among people with the target condition

examples.en: I asked what test sensitivity meant in the information sheet for the program.
examples.zh: 我问项目资料单上的「检测敏感度」是什么意思。

examples.en: The lecturer contrasted test sensitivity with specificity using a fictional screening example.
examples.zh: 讲师用一个虚构的筛查例子，对比了「检测敏感度」和特异度。

words.enDefinition: the proportion correctly testing negative among people without the target condition

examples.en: The lecturer used a chart to explain test specificity during the health workshop.
examples.zh: 讲师在健康讲座上用图表解释了「检测特异度」。

examples.en: I asked where test specificity was defined in the screening program's booklet.
examples.zh: 我问筛查项目册子上哪里给了「检测特异度」的定义。

words.enDefinition: another instance of a test that has already been performed

examples.en: The clinic told me where the repeat test would be shown in my records.
examples.zh: 诊所告诉我，「重复检测」会在我的记录里什么位置显示。

examples.en: I asked why the appointment was described as a repeat test on the portal.
examples.zh: 我问为什么平台上把这次预约写成「重复检测」。

collocations: a request for a repeat test

words.enDefinition: a follow-up test intended to verify an earlier finding

examples.en: I asked what confirmatory test meant in the letter from the screening clinic.
examples.zh: 我问筛查诊所寄来的信里，「确认检测」是什么意思。

examples.en: The clinician explained why the confirmatory test had a separate entry in my records.
examples.zh: 医生解释了为什么我的记录里单独列了「确认检测」。

words.enDefinition: a sample too small for the laboratory to complete a test

examples.en: I called the clinic about the insufficient sample message on the results page.
examples.zh: 我打电话给诊所，询问结果页面上「样本量不足」的提示。

examples.en: The lab recorded an insufficient sample and the clinic sent me a message.
examples.zh: 检验室记录了「样本量不足」，诊所给我发来一条通知。

words.enDefinition: a screening service that travels to different locations

examples.en: The mobile screening clinic was parked near the gym on Wednesday morning.
examples.zh: 周三上午，车载「流动筛查点」停在健身馆附近。

examples.en: I checked which days the mobile screening clinic would be available near campus.
examples.zh: 我查了「流动筛查点」哪几天会到学校附近。

words.enDefinition: a university event offering health information or services to students

examples.en: I picked up a screening brochure at the campus health fair after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我在「校园健康活动」上领了一份筛查资料。

examples.en: The campus health fair included a table where students could ask about local clinics.
examples.zh: 「校园健康活动」上设了咨询桌，学生可以问附近有哪些诊所。

collocations: a booth at the campus health fair

words.enDefinition: an official message informing people about a health issue or service

examples.en: The university linked to a public health notice in its weekly newsletter.
examples.zh: 学校在每周简讯里附了「公共卫生公告」的链接。

examples.en: I asked whether the public health notice was also available in another language.
examples.zh: 我问「公共卫生公告」有没有其他语言版本。
